A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
My song will be of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make his faith clear to all generations.
（以斯拉人以探的訓誨詩。）我要歌唱耶和華的慈愛，直到永遠；我要用口將你的信實傳與萬代。
For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
For you have said, Mercy will be made strong for ever; my faith will be unchanging in the heavens.
因我曾說：你的慈悲必建立到永遠；你的信實必堅立在天上。
You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
I have made an agreement with the man of my selection, I have made an oath to David my servant;
我與我所揀選的人立了約，向我的僕人大衛起了誓：
‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah
I will make your seed go on for ever, your kingdom will be strong through all generations. (Selah.)
我要建立你的後裔，直到永遠；要建立你的寶座，直到萬代。（細拉）
The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.
In heaven let them give praise for your wonders, O Lord; and your unchanging faith among the saints.
耶和華啊，諸天要稱讚你的奇事；在聖者的會中，要稱讚你的信實。
For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
For who is there in the heavens in comparison with the Lord? who is like the Lord among the sons of the gods?
在天空誰能比耶和華呢？神的眾子中，誰能像耶和華呢？
In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
God is greatly to be feared among the saints, and to be honoured over all those who are about him.
他在聖者的會中，是大有威嚴的神，比一切在他四圍的更可畏懼。
O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
O Lord God of armies, who is strong like you, O Jah? and your unchanging faith is round about you.
耶和華─萬軍之神啊，哪一個大能者像你耶和華？你的信實是在你的四圍。
You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
You have rule over the sea in storm; when its waves are troubled, you make them calm.
你管轄海的狂傲；波浪翻騰，你就使它平靜了。
You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
Rahab was crushed by you like one wounded to death; with your strong arm you put to flight all your haters.
你打碎了拉哈伯，似乎是已殺的人；你用有能的膀臂打散了你的仇敵。
The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
Yours are the heavens, and the earth is yours; you have made the world, and everything which is in it.
天屬你，地也屬你；世界和其中所充滿的都為你所建立。
North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
You have made the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon are sounding with joy at your name.
南北為你所創造；他泊和黑門都因你的名歡呼。
Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.
Yours is an arm of power; strong is your hand and high your right hand.
你有大能的膀臂；你的手有力，你的右手也高舉。
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
The seat of your kingdom is resting on righteousness and right judging: mercy and good faith come before your face.
公義和公平是你寶座的根基；慈愛和誠實行在你前面。
Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
Happy are the people who have knowledge of the holy cry: the light of your face, O Lord, will be shining on their way.
知道向你歡呼的，那民是有福的！耶和華啊，他們在你臉上的光裡行走。
They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.
In your name will they have joy all the day: in your righteousness will they be lifted up.
他們因你的名終日歡樂，因你的公義得以高舉。
For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
For you are the glory of their strength; in your pleasure will our horn be lifted up.
你是他們力量的榮耀；因為你喜悅我們，我們的角必被高舉。
Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
For our breastplate is the Lord; and our king is the Holy One of Israel's.
我們的盾牌屬耶和華；我們的王屬以色列的聖者。
You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
Then your voice came to your holy one in a vision, saying, I have put the crown on a strong one, lifting up one taken from among the people.
當時，你在異象中曉諭你的聖民，說：我已把救助之力加在那有能者的身上；我高舉那從民中所揀選的。
I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
I have made discovery of David my servant; I have put my holy oil on his head.
我尋得我的僕人大衛，用我的聖膏膏他。
My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.
My hand will be his support; my arm will give him strength.
我的手必使他堅立；我的膀臂也必堅固他。
No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
The deceit of those who are against him will not overcome him; he will not be troubled by the sons of evil.
仇敵必不勒索他；凶惡之子也不苦害他。
I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
I will have those who are against him broken before his face, and his haters will be crushed under my blows.
我要在他面前打碎他的敵人，擊殺那恨他的人。
My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.
But my faith and my mercy will be with him; and in my name will his horn be lifted up.
只是我的信實和我的慈愛要與他同在；因我的名，他的角必被高舉。
I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
I will put his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
我要使他的左手伸到海上，右手伸到河上。
He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
He will say to me, You are my father, my God, and the Rock of my salvation.
他要稱呼我說：你是我的父，是我的神，是拯救我的磐石。
I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
And I will make him the first of my sons, most high over the kings of the earth.
我也要立他為長子，為世上最高的君王。
I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
I will keep my mercy for him for ever; my agreement with him will not be changed.
我要為他存留我的慈愛，直到永遠；我與他立的約必要堅定。
I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
His seed will keep their place for ever; his kingdom will be eternal, like the heavens.
我也要使他的後裔存到永遠，使他的寶座如天之久。
If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
If his children give up my law, and are not ruled by my decisions;
倘若他的子孫離棄我的律法，不照我的典章行，
if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
If my rules are broken, and my orders are not kept;
背棄我的律例，不遵守我的誡命，
I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
Then I will send punishment on them for their sin; my rod will be the reward of their evil-doing.
我就要用杖責罰他們的過犯，用鞭責罰他們的罪孽。
But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
But I will not take away my mercy from him, and will not be false to my faith.
只是我必不將我的慈愛全然收回，也必不叫我的信實廢棄。
I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
I will be true to my agreement; the things which have gone out of my lips will not be changed.
我必不背棄我的約，也不改變我口中所出的。
Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness— I will not lie to David—
I have made an oath once by my holy name, that I will not be false to David.
我一次指著自己的聖潔起誓：我決不向大衛說謊！
his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
His seed will not come to an end for ever; the seat of his kingdom will be like the sun before me.
他的後裔要存到永遠；他的寶座在我面前如日之恆一般，
like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah
It will be fixed for ever like the moon; and the witness in heaven is true. (Selah.)
又如月亮永遠堅立，如天上確實的見證。（細拉）
Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.
But you have put him away in disgust; you have been angry with the king of your selection.
但你惱怒你的受膏者，就丟掉棄絕他。
You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
You have made your agreement with your servant of no effect: you have had no respect for his crown, it has come down even to the earth.
你厭惡了與僕人所立的約，將他的冠冕踐踏於地。
You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
All his walls are broken down; you have given his strong towers to destruction.
你拆毀了他一切的籬笆，使他的保障變為荒場。
All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
All those who come by take away his goods; he is laughed at by his neighbours.
凡過路的人都搶奪他；他成為鄰邦的羞辱。
You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
You have given power to the right hand of his haters; you have made glad all those who are against him.
你高舉了他敵人的右手；你叫他一切的仇敵歡喜。
You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
His sword is turned back; you have not been his support in the fight.
你叫他的刀劍捲刃，叫他在爭戰之中站立不住。
You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
You have put an end to his glory: the seat of his kingdom has been levelled to the earth.
你使他的光輝止息，將他的寶座推倒於地。
You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah
You have made him old before his time; he is covered with shame. (Selah.)
你減少他青年的日子，又使他蒙羞。（細拉）
How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
How long, O Lord, will you Keep yourself for ever from our eyes? how long will your wrath be burning like fire?
耶和華啊，這要到幾時呢？你要將自己隱藏到永遠嗎？你的忿怒如火焚燒要到幾時呢？
Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
See how short my time is; why have you made all men for no purpose?
求你想念我的時候是何等的短少；你創造世人，要使他們歸何等的虛空呢？
What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
What man now living will not see death? will he be able to keep back his soul from the underworld? (Selah.)
誰能常活免死、救他的靈魂脫離陰間的權柄呢？（細拉）
Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
Lord, where are your earlier mercies? where is the oath which you made to David in unchanging faith?
主啊，你從前憑你的信實向大衛立誓要施行的慈愛在哪裡呢？
Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people—
Keep in mind, O Lord, the shame of your servants, and how the bitter words of all the people have come into my heart;
主啊，求你記念僕人們所受的羞辱，記念我怎樣將一切強盛民的羞辱存在我懷裡。
how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!
The bitter words of your haters, O Lord, shaming the footsteps of your king.
耶和華啊，你的仇敵用這羞辱羞辱了你的僕人，羞辱了你受膏者的腳蹤。
Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
Let the Lord be praised for ever. So be it, So be it.
耶和華是應當稱頌的，直到永遠。阿們！阿們！
